primaryChecks.text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 戦闘でイスラエル人が倒れた場所として山名が明記。

primaryChecks.text: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 戦闘でイスラエル人が倒れた場所として山名が明記。
